description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class for testing the AccessFlowStateMachineDao data access object in the OrangeHRM project. It contains multiple test methods that verify CRUD operations, query methods, and business logic related to workflow state machines.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of AccessFlowStateMachineDao methods related to workflow state machine management. It tests CRUD operations, query methods, and role-based access controls.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForExistingAction
methods.description: Verifies that getAllowedActions returns correct WorkflowStateMachine objects for existing actions.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForNonExistingAction
methods.description: Checks that getAllowedActions returns null when no actions are available for the given parameters.

methods.name: testGetNextStateForExistingState
methods.description: Confirms that getNextState returns the correct next state entity for valid current states.

methods.name: testGetNextStateForInvalidState
methods.description: Verifies that getNextState returns null for invalid or non-existent states.

methods.name: testGetActionableStates
methods.description: Tests retrieval of actionable states based on current state, role, and actions.

methods.name: testSaveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Ensures that a WorkflowStateMachine record can be stored and its properties verified.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Checks deletion of a specific workflow state machine record.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of workflow state machine records for a given workflow.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecordsNullWorkflow
methods.description: Ensures empty list returned when querying with non-existent workflow id.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if specific actions are allowed within a workflow for a role.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedForNonEntry
methods.description: Verifies restriction of actions not allowed in current states.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsExisting
methods.description: Confirms retrieval of allowed workflow items when specific parameters are provided.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsAllStates
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all workflow items irrespective of current state.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsNotExisting
methods.description: Verifies no items are returned for non-matching criteria.

methods.name: testGetWorkflowItemsByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific WorkflowStateMachine by state, action, and role.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Verifies bulk deletion of workflow records for a role, and that other roles remain unaffected.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRoleAllWorkflows
methods.description: Verifies deletion of all workflow records for a role across all workflows.

methods.name: testHandleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Ensures related workflow records' roles are correctly updated when a role is renamed.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemIdsForRole
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves workflow item IDs for a given workflow and role for internal testing.
